etymologies.etymologyHTML: From replace +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: A person or thing that takes the place of another; a substitute.

quote.citation: 2010 December 28, Kevin Darlin, “West Brom 1 - 3 Blackburn”, in BBC‎[1]:
quote.text: Rovers lost keeper Robinson to a calf problem at half-time and his replacement Mark Bunn, making his Premier League debut, was immediately called into action - pushing away a vicious Peter Odemwingie drive at the near post.

definitions.definition: The removal of an edge of crystal, by one plane or more.
